build_task_bridge_scene: build a PHYRE bridge task scene with containers, walls, slopes, and a dynamic ball using build_task
create_task_template_with_decorator: create a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search parameters
add_container_goal: add a goal container to the PHYRE scene using vt.add_container with vertex coordinates
add_box_bridge_segments: add static box segments as a bridge using vt.add_box with position and flip_lr parameters
add_convex_polygon_slope: add a convex polygon slope to the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon with converted vertices
